svg.title: Chatham IV: interpretive SVG study
svg.desc: Two joined monochrome panels forming an inverted L. Approximate geometry, interpretive screen palette, transparent background. The source names the lower colour red-orange. This interpretive study groups it under red for filtering. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.moma.org/d/pdfs/W1siZiIsIjIwMTgvMDYvMTMvOGlvazUweWl5aF9LZWxseV9DaGF0aGFtX1BSRVZJRVcxLnBkZiJdXQ/Kelly_Chatham_PREVIEW1.pdf?sha=cc613fbfe3ec18ec; reviewed 2026-10-26; interpretive reconstruction, not a facsimile.
